title: Website Manager
description:
* Hands-on experience managing corporate websites built on ASP.NET / .NET or other enterprise CMS platforms.
* Working knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and basic SQL.
* Understanding of ASP.NET website architecture, including page templates, content management workflows and backend functionality.
* Ability to troubleshoot website issues and coordinate with developers for code-level changes.
* Familiarity with website hosting, domains, SSL certificates, redirects, backups and deployment workflows.
* Experience with CMS platforms such as Sitecore, Umbraco, Kentico, Optimizely or other enterprise CMS solutions, where applicable.

* Leave encashment

Experience:

* ASP.NET: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
